messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person's entire outfit with the complete outfit shown in the reference images, consisting of the top, the skirt, and the footwear. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view. Remove any original clothing or footwear that is not part of this target outfit. Keep all non-clothing attributes unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person's entire outfit with the complete outfit shown from the front and back in the reference images, consisting of the top, the skirt, and the footwear. Remove any original clothing or footwear that is not part of this target outfit. Keep all non-clothing attributes unchanged. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands and slowly turns her head and upper body from facing forward to a right-facing profile.","camera":"A medium shot at eye level that remains mostly static while the subject rotates.","clothing":"A bright pink long-sleeved collared top and a matching pleated skirt.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Black hair with straight bangs, pulled back into a high ponytail.","identity":"A young woman with a slender build and light skin, shown from the thighs up.","scene":"An outdoor area with stone buildings, metal railings, pipes, rocks, and a green hillside under a clear blue sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The original colorful patterned dress was replaced by a bright pink long-sleeved collared top and matching pleated skirt. The character's hair, face, pose, camera, and outdoor scene remain consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's entire outfit with the reference outfit: pink long-sleeved collared top, matching pleated skirt, and black lace-up boots, removing original clothing and footwear while keeping non-clothing attributes unchanged.
uncertain: Footwear is not visible in the medium shot, so it is unclear whether the black boots were added.
